text: S379 exit: actual S378 same-revision FRONT_FLAT SVG leaders were compared against source-derived paths and Chromium glyph bounds for all 17 option rows. The renderer emits 12–13 POM leaders per row (220 total). Every row has at least 10 leaders under the unchanged 0.25 cm path-clearance gate; `standFrontRise-min` has 11. Across rows, 11 source POMs fail at least once: 10 fail all 17 rows, while front-body-length-hps-hem fails at standFrontRise-min. There are 141 segment/path crossings, 30 additional sub-0.25 cm path clearances, 51 leader-pair contacts under 0.25 cm (three recurring pairs), and three measured leader-to-text intersections. The C marker approval arrived during this slice and is recorded for S380; it fixes only the prior C TEXT_COLLISION, not these remaining crossings or any held face. No code, geometry, gate or acceptance changed. All 34 Polo faces stay held; V02 remains open and V03 gated. See S379 packet and matrices.

S379 records 17-option Polo front leader/path/label failures with exact source IDs, targets, options, clearances and rendered evidence. All G04 holds and gates remain.
